public_title: Acids and Bases: Acidity and Alkalinity in Everyday Substances
subtopic: pH, strong versus weak acids and bases, and neutralization
published_summary_paraphrase: The detail page describes measuring pH and choosing among acids and bases to mix.
reported_inputs: Sample solutions and a choice of acid/base strength
reported_controls: Choose solutions to mix and reset the simulation
reported_pedagogical_format: Choice-enabled within a guided simulation, as described by Labster
our_possible_reuse: Reuse a virtual pH meter and certified qualitative reference solutions. Offer a separate supported-variable panel that exposes model domain and measurement scale.

subtopic: Conservation of atom counts in chemical equations involving polyatomic ions
published_summary_paraphrase: The catalog presents a practice exercise around balancing equations.
our_possible_reuse: Provide an accessible symbolic editor that exposes counts and accepts equivalent balances. Add charge balance for ionic forms only in approved curriculum.

public_title: Basic Electricity: Understand how electricity works
subtopic: Current, voltage, charge and a complete circuit
published_summary_paraphrase: The official description connects construction of a complete circuit with restoration of power.
reported_outputs_or_observations: Complete circuit and qualitative charge/energy concepts
our_possible_reuse: Give learners an accessible circuit board and synchronized 2D connections list. Derive ideal meter values from a qualified circuit model.

public_title: Cell Structure: Cell theory and internal organelles
subtopic: Comparison of cell types and identification of organelles
published_summary_paraphrase: The listing describes observing cell samples and placing organelles in a cell representation.
reported_controls: Choose organelles for represented cell types
our_possible_reuse: Use local teacher-reviewed plant, cheek and curated comparator images. Keep organelle diagrams, optical visibility and image evidence distinct.

published_summary_paraphrase: The vendor describes using a pool-table scenario to predict and compare elastic and inelastic outcomes.
our_possible_reuse: Use an original track with two carts and accessible time-series tables. Expose idealized assumptions and conservation error.

public_title: Conservation of Energy (Principles): Unleash the roller coaster's potential
subtopic: Energy conservation in a frictionless model
published_summary_paraphrase: The product page describes changes to an isolated system and comparison of kinetic and potential energies.
reported_outputs_or_observations: Kinetic, potential and total mechanical energy
reported_inputs: Changes to an isolated system under a frictionless model
reported_apparatus_or_materials: Virtual roller coaster and test track
reported_pedagogical_format: Choice-enabled within a guided simulation, as described by Labster
our_possible_reuse: Use two school track heights and a graph of measured quantities with units. Keep the isolated-system assumption visible during graph interpretation.

subtopic: Resolution, sample visibility and optical technique comparisons
published_summary_paraphrase: The vendor describes comparison of small-intestine imagery in light, fluorescence and electron microscopy.
reported_outputs_or_observations: Identification and interpretation of image features
reported_apparatus_or_materials: Prepared tissue slide and light, fluorescence and electron microscopy views
reported_controls: Change the displayed scale of a microscopic image
our_possible_reuse: Ship rights-verified prepared slide imagery with recorded scales and source-device provenance. Offer focus using safe pre-recorded planes and keyboard controls.

public_title: Mitosis: Using a toxic compound from the yew tree in cancer therapy
subtopic: Cell-cycle stages and the visual patterns of mitosis
published_summary_paraphrase: The official page documents staged cell-division observations through microscopy and an animation.
reported_apparatus_or_materials: Cell imagery, onion sample and microscopy views
reported_quizzes_or_feedback: Interactive graphics and questions on cell-cycle stages
our_possible_reuse: Select teacher-reviewed prepared images and express inter-rater ambiguity for borderline views. Reuse the optical viewer and image evidence table.

public_title: Physical and Chemical Changes: Escape the hostile planet!
published_summary_paraphrase: Learners are asked to distinguish physical and chemical changes by their observations.
our_possible_reuse: Make independent school-context evidence cards. Ask for a justification and permit repeat observation before grading.

public_title: Titration: Neutralize an acid lake contamination
subtopic: Colorimetric titration and estimation of an unknown concentration
published_summary_paraphrase: The vendor describes assembling apparatus and interpreting the indicator endpoint. Volumetric precision is a stated objective.
reported_inputs: Indicator choice, sample volume, titrant volume and repeats
reported_apparatus_or_materials: Burette, stand, clamp, flask, indicator and base solution
reported_controls: Assemble apparatus, vary selected inputs and repeat
reported_pedagogical_format: Choice-enabled quantitative exercise, as described by Labster
our_possible_reuse: One reusable burette, pipette, flask and volume ledger. Treat endpoint uncertainty separately from model equivalence.

subtopic: Food webs, trophic levels and ecological pyramids
published_summary_paraphrase: The publisher describes a story outside the laboratory organized around feeding relationships.
our_possible_reuse: Build an independently sourced local food web with a verified species-role dataset. Offer a 2D keyboard-usable node-and-edge editor and model scope notes.

public_title: Vectors and Scalars: Guide two astronauts on a mission to Mars
subtopic: Components, magnitude, direction and scalar/vector comparison
published_summary_paraphrase: The task is contextualized as route planning using positions and directions.
reported_apparatus_or_materials: Control panel, satellite imagery and a virtual rover
reported_controls: Guide movement in a Cartesian coordinate frame
our_possible_reuse: Use a survey map with a keyboard-adjustable vector and an equivalent coordinate table. Keep route scoring transparent.
